legend: You regularly visit a taverna in Heraklion for meze, a selection of small dishes. To keep the dinners varied, the cook alternates between two recipes for each dish.
The menu offers $$$n$$$ dishes, numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$. Each dish has two versions: the first and the second.

Each day, you choose an integer $$$k$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ and order one portion of each of the first $$$k$$$ dishes: dishes $$$1,2,\ldots,k$$$. You cannot choose their versions. The first time you order a dish, you receive its first version. On every subsequent occasion, you receive the opposite version from the last time you ordered that dish. Days when you do not order a dish do not affect its version.
Two daily orders are identical if they contain the same number of dishes and the version of each corresponding dish is the same.
Construct a sequence $$$k_1,k_2,\ldots,k_m$$$ of maximum possible length such that no two daily orders are identical.
input: The only line contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 20$$$), the number of dishes.
output: In the first line, print an integer $$$m$$$, the maximum possible number of days.
In the second line, print $$$m$$$ integers $$$k_1,k_2,\ldots,k_m$$$ ($$$1 \le k_i \le n$$$), the number of dishes to order on each day.
If there are several optimal sequences, print any of them.
note: In the first example, order the only dish twice. You receive its first version and then its second version.

In the second example, the sequence $$$2,2,1,2,2,1$$$ produces the following orders. The numbers in parentheses are the versions of dishes $$$1,2,\ldots,k$$$: $$ (1,1),\quad (2,2),\quad (1),\quad (2,1),\quad (1,2),\quad (2). $$ All six orders are distinct.

legend.ai: 你经常去伊拉克利翁的一家小酒馆吃梅泽，这是一种由多道小菜组成的餐食。为了让晚餐保持多样，厨师会为每道菜交替采用两种食谱。
菜单上有 $$$n$$$ 道菜，编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$。每道菜都有两个版本：第一版和第二版。
每天，你选择一个整数 $$$k$$$，范围为 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$，并为前 $$$k$$$ 道菜各点一份：菜品为 $$$1,2,\ldots,k$$$。你无法选择菜品的版本。第一次点某道菜时，你会得到它的第一个版本。之后每次点这道菜时，你得到的版本都与上次点它时相反。没有点某道菜的日子不会影响它的版本。
如果两个每日订单包含相同数量的菜品，且每道对应菜品的版本都相同，那么它们就是相同的。
构造一个长度尽可能大的序列 $$$k_1,k_2,\ldots,k_m$$$，使得任意两天的订单都不相同。

input.ai: 唯一一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 20$$$)，表示菜肴的数量。

output.ai: 在第一行输出一个整数 $$$m$$$，表示可能的最大天数。
在第二行输出 $$$m$$$ 个整数 $$$k_1,k_2,\ldots,k_m$$$($$$1 \le k_i \le n$$$)，表示每天要点的菜品数量。
如果存在多个最优序列，输出其中任意一个即可。

note.ai: 在第一个示例中，将唯一的菜品点两次。你会先收到它的第一份，然后收到它的第二份。
在第二个示例中，序列 $$$2,2,1,2,2,1$$$ 会产生以下几种订单。括号中的数字表示菜品 $$$1,2,\ldots,k$$$ 的版本：$$ (1,1),\quad (2,2),\quad (1),\quad (2,1),\quad (1,2),\quad (2). $$ 这六种订单互不相同。
